## Overview

Kaggle Simulation Competition — [Google Research Football with Manchester City F.C.](https://www.kaggle.com/c/google-football/overview)

Built a Docker setup for the kaggle + Google Football simulation environment with Jupyter notebook integration. Created a framework for pool play simulation matches between different agents, published as a notebook on Kaggle.

![Agent pool play simulation](thumbnail.gif)

**Highlights:**

- Docker environment for kaggle + Google Football simulation
- Local agent pool play match framework
- Analysis notebooks and ML agent exploration
